question_text: Will NYC subway ridership reach 85% of the pre-Covid average before Jan 1, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
If NYC subway ridership reaches a seven-day average of at least 3.95 million riders before Jan 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
The subway had an average daily ridership of 4.65 million persons in 2019.
